_comment: The pain flow: Body area → Pain level & start time → Notes → Save, then a summary. BodyMapPicker (lib/catalog/body_map_picker/body_map_picker.dart, the tappable front/back figure) and SeverityInput (lib/catalog/severity_input/severity_input.dart, here labelled "Pain level") are custom catalog components written in Dart; titles, buttons and the start time are built-in components. Notes and the summary reuse ../shared/notes.json and ../shared/summary.json with this flow's values for their {{slots}}; routing and placeholders work like ../nutrition/flow.json.

with.notesHint: e.g. Sharp when I bend, eases when I lie down
